expectations.text: States enforcement has begun: the AI Office issued its first formal requests for information to GPAI providers under Article 91, first reported in late August 2026
expectations.evidence: "Late August 2026: the first formal Art. 91 requests for information to GPAI providers were reported." and opening "Short answer: yes. Enforcement has started"

expectations.text: Mentions the further wave announced October 14, 2026 covering security practices, external evaluation and post-market monitoring
expectations.evidence: "14 Oct 2026: the AI Office announced a further wave of Art. 91 requests. It covers security practices, external evaluation, and post-market monitoring."

expectations.text: Uses hedged language and does not name recipients, noting they have not been officially identified
expectations.evidence: "The recipients of the requests have not been officially named. Treat press attribution to specific companies as unconfirmed."

expectations.text: References the procedural framework: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755, in force August 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: "10 Aug 2026: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755 entered into force."

expectations.text: States the GPAI fine exposure correctly: up to EUR 15M or 3 percent of worldwide turnover
expectations.evidence: "fines (Art. 101) of up to EUR 15M or 3% of worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher"
